about.title: About HFST
about.subtitle: Dedicated to empowering the next generation through accessible education.
about.mission_p1: Hope for Students Tanzania (HFST) is a non-governmental organization committed to ensuring that no child in Tanzania is left behind due to financial constraints. We believe that education is the most powerful tool to break the cycle of poverty.
about.mission_p2: Through the generous support of our donors, we provide school fees, textbooks, uniforms, and essential learning materials to students across primary, secondary, and university levels.
about.integrity_desc: We operate with complete transparency, ensuring every donation directly impacts a student's life.
about.empowerment_desc: We believe in empowering individuals to reach their full potential and uplift their communities.
about.impact_desc: We are driven by measurable results and creating a lasting, positive impact on society.
